summary: Akanda Corp. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing receipt of a Nasdaq deficiency notice for failing the minimum stockholders' equity requirement under Listing Rule 5550(b)(1). The company had negative equity of −$11.99 million as of December 31, 2025. Nasdaq gave 45 days (to July 31, 2026) to submit a compliance plan, with a possible 180-day extension if accepted. No price, premium, board recommendation, or deal mechanics are involved; this is a routine listing standards notification. What to watch: the timeline for plan submission and potential equity infusion or reverse split to regain compliance.
